properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: Previous the site of a public house/hotel that had been cleared a number of years ago following closure. Redevelopment of the vacant land enable by two separate but associated consents, delivering an overall scheme of 11 dwellings. An initial application for 5 dwellings was permitted in 2010 (10/S/00291/FUL). This was followed by a further consent for 6 homes, granted afterwards (12/00884/FUL). The two proposals create one contiguous terrace and were considered one scheme. Development of 11 dwellings completed in 2017/18.
